/* 대국민포털_게시물기본 목록 조회 (PstMapper.selectPstList) */ SELECT p.pst_sn ,p.bbs_id ,p.pst_ttl ,p.pst_cn ,p.pst_inq_cnt ,p.fix_yn , CASE WHEN b.dept_expsr_yn = 'Y' THEN p.wrtr_dept_nm ELSE '' END AS wrtr_dept_nm ,p.mdfr_dept_nm ,p.rgtr_id ,DATE(p.reg_dt) as reg_dt ,p.vdo_url_addr as video_id ,p.mdfr_id ,p.mdfcn_dt ,ft.srvr_file_nm as thmb_file_nm ,p.thmb_expln_cn ,p.vdo_expln_cn FROM kids_own.TB_PP_M_BBS b , kids_own.TB_PP_M_BBS_AUTHRT ba , kids_own.TB_PP_M_PST p LEFT OUTER JOIN kids_own.TB_CA_E_FILE_TRSM ft ON ft.atch_file_group_id = p.thmb_id AND ft.atch_file_id = (SELECT MAX(f.atch_file_id) FROM kids_own.tb_ca_e_file_trsm f WHERE f.atch_file_group_id = p.thmb_id) WHERE p.bbs_id = #{bbsId} AND ba.authrt_cd = 'BBS_USR' AND b.bbs_id = ba.bbs_id AND b.bbs_id = p.bbs_id AND b.use_yn = 'Y' AND p.expsr_yn = 'Y'
AND lower(p.pst_ttl) LIKE '%' || lower(#{searchWrd}) || '%'
AND lower(p.pst_cn) LIKE '%' || lower(#{searchWrd}) || '%'
ORDER BY p.fix_yn DESC, p.reg_dt DESC

/* 대국민포털_게시물기본 조회 (PstMapper.getPst) */ SELECT p.pst_sn ,p.bbs_id ,p.pst_ttl ,p.pst_cn ,p.pst_inq_cnt ,p.pst_kogl_cprgt_type_cd ,p.atch_file_group_id ,p.thmb_id ,p.fix_yn , CASE WHEN b.dept_expsr_yn = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(ei.emp_nm || ' [' || p.wrtr_dept_nm || ']', p.wrtr_dept_nm) ELSE ei.emp_nm END AS wrtr_dept_nm ,p.mdfr_dept_nm ,p.rgtr_id ,DATE(p.reg_dt) as reg_dt ,p.vdo_url_addr as video_id ,p.mdfr_id ,p.mdfcn_dt ,(SELECT ft.srvr_file_nm FROM kids_own.TB_CA_E_FILE_TRSM ft WHERE ft.atch_file_group_id = p.atch_file_group_id ORDER BY ft.file_seq ASC, ft.reg_dt ASC LIMIT 1) as img_file_nm ,p.thmb_expln_cn ,p.vdo_expln_cn FROM kids_own.TB_PP_M_PST p LEFT OUTER JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_emp_info ei ON p.rgtr_id = ei.emp_no , kids_own.TB_PP_M_BBS b , kids_own.TB_PP_M_BBS_AUTHRT ba WHERE p.bbs_id = #{bbsId} AND p.pst_sn = #{pstSn} AND p.bbs_id = b.bbs_id AND ba.authrt_cd = 'BBS_USR' AND b.bbs_id = ba.bbs_id AND b.use_yn = 'Y' AND p.expsr_yn = 'Y'
SELECT atch_file_id , atch_file_group_id , file_seq , file_nm , file_extn_nm , file_sz FROM kids_own.TB_CA_E_FILE_TRSM WHERE atch_file_group_id = #{atchFileGroupId} ORDER BY file_seq ASC, reg_dt ASC
